name: elm-coverage-tooling

scripts.test: npm run test:elm && npm run test:js
scripts.build:elm:instrument: mkdir -p dist && cd src-elm/instrument && elm-esm make src/Main.elm --output=../../dist/elm-instrument.js && cp ../../src/elm-instrument.d.ts ../../dist/elm-instrument.d.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:elm && npm run build:js

author: Martin Janiczek (@janiczek)
description: Library and CLI tools for instrumenting Elm code and gathering line and edge coverage.
